title: LeaverReviewOpen
description: Sent by the control plane's leaver workflow, signed with the tenant's service secret: open the review of a leaver's personal knowledge layer and freeze it. Repeating an id is safe. A live (Entra) leaver names the person and deciders by user and carries the leaving's HR generation; once the person is fenced at a later generation, it is refused as superseded.

id.description: The leaver workflow's id and run id: unique per leaving, stable across retries.

generation.description: Live (Entra) mode: the leaver's HR generation, which orders this call against a rehire's fence. Required with person.user; absent for a legacy leaver.

user.description: Live (Entra) mode: the identity the knowledge service knows the person by.

deciders.description: Candidate deciders in order of preference: the manager, then instance sponsors. The first who is not the leaver decides; with none, the tenant's privacy officers do. A live leaver names deciders by user.
